degree_rationale: How the body is fashioned with senses arranged like rooms in a city — eyes, ears, nose, mouth, hands each having storehouses, treasuries, gates with watchmen and nets; the heart-king and his cellarer; the Mind of Light coming to take the keys. Mechanism of cognition and inward storage.
direction_rationale: Pure inward receptive architecture — the city-of-cognition with its gates, storehouses, nets, watchers. The intellectual reception structure par excellence.
grand_man_function: Spiritual cognitive city — the inner reception architecture of senses.
title: How the senses are arranged in the body like rooms in a city for cognition
